integrityTriggers.sqlstate: P0311 (= immutable_violation, classified distinctly from generic 23514)
integrityTriggers.migrationInclusion: trigger DDL appended into the SAME migration file 0000 (custom SQL after drizzle-kit generation, separated by statement-breakpoints); migrator applies tables + triggers in one transaction. drizzle-kit 0.31 journal stores no per-file hash; migrator hashes the file content at apply time so appended trigger SQL is consistent.

triggers.name: trg_audio_chunks_immutable
triggers.rule: raise P0311 when OLD.finalized_at IS NOT NULL; allows the NULL->set finalize mutation

triggers.name: trg_meeting_language_mode_lock
triggers.rule: raise P0311 when (language or mode changes) AND OLD.state NOT IN ('draft','checking')

triggers.name: trg_meeting_capture_sources_lock
triggers.rule: raise P0311 when parent meeting state NOT IN ('draft','checking')

deviationsFromDesign.item: drizzle-orm / drizzle-kit bumped to latest matched pair (0.45.2 / 0.31.10)
deviationsFromDesign.justification: DESIGN floor was ^0.36.0 / ^0.28.0; the floor pair drizzle-kit 0.28.x loads the schema via CJS require and cannot resolve ESM .js->.ts relative imports, failing generation. drizzle-kit 0.30+ bundles the schema with esbuild (resolves .js->.ts). DESIGN §1.1 explicitly permits bumping the matched pair. API surface used (pgTable/pgEnum/check/index/uuid/bigint/timestamp/jsonb, postgres-js client + migrator, PostgresJsDatabase) is stable across 0.36->0.45. No contract change.

DESIGN §1.1 lists '@testcontainers/postgres', but that name 404s on the npm registry (verified against https://registry.npmjs.org). The real published package is '@testcontainers/postgresql' (v10.28.0). Import API (PostgreSqlContainer.getConnectionUri) matches DESIGN intent exactly. No contract change.

deviationsFromDesign.item: uniqueDbName implemented locally in test/harness.ts instead of re-exporting @kms/test-support
deviationsFromDesign.justification: DESIGN §1.1/§8 dependency list for @kms/database does not include @kms/test-support; adding an undeclared workspace dep would contradict the explicit dep set. The local helper mirrors the uniqueNamespace algorithm (counter+timestamp, Postgres-safe). Behavior identical; handoff item if a shared helper is later required.

deviationsFromDesign.item: owner_id single-column index added to user-data tables without an owner-leading DESIGN index (capture_intervals, timeline_markers, audio_chunks, audio_manifests, audio_assets)
deviationsFromDesign.justification: DESIGN §4 convention mandates an owner_id index on every user-data table; per-table index lists did not all include one. Added a minimal (owner_id) index per table to honor the convention. All DESIGN-listed indexes are also present exactly as specified.

safety.contentFree: true — fixtures are synthetic (no real meeting text/audio/credentials); passing run emits no SQL text or content (errors only surface on failure); evidence contains no secrets
safety.testIsolation: per-test transaction rollback via withRollbackTx; one container per file migrated once in beforeAll; Ryuk enabled, withStartupTimeout(60s)
